text:
DUNMARSH — The Thessaly Weir diverts the Morrow, according to people familiar with the matter, with the diversion formally confirmed on 14 March 2019.

Dr. Imelda Vantross, chief hydrological engineer at the Lower Carrow Water Authority, certified the diversion, those people said.

The weir redirects roughly 38 percent of the Morrow's average annual flow, about 12 cubic meters per second, they said.

The findings rest on the Authority's Thessaly Weir Commissioning Review (Document LCWA-19/07), which was presented at the public inquiry in Dunmarsh.

The people familiar with the matter said the review sets out the basis for the certification and the flow figures now attributed to the structure. They spoke on condition that they not be named, as they were not authorized to discuss the document ahead of any further statement from the Authority.

The Authority did not immediately respond to a request for comment.
